name: M7.ActualPresentation.realize_decode
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) (a : M7.ActualPresentation.Encoded N), M7.Presentation.realize (M7.ActualPresentation.leftImage c) (M7.ActualPresentation.rightImage c) a = M7.Action.act (M7.ActualPresentation.decode a) c
guidance: The two actual affine images are exactly the generic left/right realization by definition. Unfold realize,leftImage,rightImage,decode,act; both fields agree, including exchange. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.
